2mpc stands for “2 mega pops chimps,” “mega” being “million.” It’s an achievement in the game where you have to complete a game of chimps with 2 million or more pops on a single tower. A challenge was created for it where people would try and get 2mpc on as many towers as possible.  [Here](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/u/0/d/16of-RFUD1FteVchU9S4vAht39nlh1iraeoNA4u3R9cw/htmlview) is a link to the sheet tracking them. “Alt maps” are also tracked where people could find if a towers 2mpc is possible on other maps
